scope: Token handling, outbound requests, public route exposure, errors, dependencies and contribution counting in this personal deployment.

credential.runtime_validation: Reject credentials unless GitHub reports exactly read:user, and reject responses for another account.
credential.storage: Vercel production Secret; never source, query parameters, responses, frontend files or request logs.

network.operations: Fixed GraphQL queries only; no mutations.
network.container: No frontend or OAuth server files, no frontend build, no lifecycle install scripts, direct Node entrypoint; build and runtime telemetry disabled.
network.requested_private_data: Numeric contribution counters from the owner's profile; no repository contents, names, messages, titles or emails.

http.query_parameters: Only the existing fixed username/theme/show_icons values; reject duplicates and other parameters.
http.output: Aggregate SVG and credential-free liveness only.
http.errors: Generic message only; do not return or log upstream payloads or token-bearing error objects.
http.cache: One hour, concurrent-request coalescing, preserve last successful aggregate card on upstream failure.

counting.period: All contribution years returned by GitHub, aggregated once per year.
counting.private_scope: read:user supports aggregate private/internal contributions without granting repository-content access.
counting.restricted_contributions: Never add unclassified restricted contributions to the commit count.
counting.streak: Keeps its separate public-only token; it does not receive PROFILE_READ_TOKEN.

dependency_audit.installation: Frozen lockfile, lifecycle scripts disabled for local review; upstream lockfile passes its release-age and supply-chain trust policies.

limits: This scoped review cannot prove the absence of unknown defects or future supply-chain compromises.
Totals describe contributions recognized and returned by GitHub, not every git commit ever created.
Only aggregate numbers are intentionally public on the profile.
